This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] distinguished by their [[Color/Legends|green]] and white skin, with starfish-shaped bodies, including [[Limb/Legends|tentacles]], as well as a single large [[Eye/Legends|eye]] in the center of their body sporting a bright red iris. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], at least three members of this species were present in a [[Casino on Qiaxx|casino]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Qiaxx]].<ref name="MJ5" />

{{Species-stub}}

Stackpole]], and illustrated by [[Carlos Ezquerra]].<ref name="MJ5" />
